admission.justification: Future changes to host intake, task projection or task-status consumers must preserve this bounded authority: duplicate task truth, unsupported paused observations, reconstructed membership or conflicting status/age presentation produce incorrect task operations. The named current source assertions guard the specified facets; this is no fresh Curator execution grade.

applicability: Task-status words and tones on the dashboard task surfaces that consume canonical TaskEntry facts.
conditions: Shared taskStatusKey/statusLabel/statusTone presentation formats the native task stage and started-task activity.
TaskStatusWord derives displayed event age from eventAt and its shared/local display clock; a missing/inactive clock does not invent epoch zero.
exclusions: Operational severity dots, process phases, dependency-readiness badges and review/landing verdict vocabulary are distinct domains, not task-status words.
No second served task-entry elapsed age or browser-derived lifecycle/frontier task truth.
